snippet.title: Check Out This New Crew-Collecting Tactical Roguelike!
snippet.description:
Live now on Steam, a new Roguelike Turn-based Tactics Game:  
Kamikaze Tactics

Wishlist now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3045260?utm_medium=youtube&utm_source=trailer

Inspired by games like X-Wing: The Miniature’s Game, Fire Emblem, and Into the Breach: Kamikaze Tactics offers a compelling and strategic experience where players command a mercenary squadron in high-stakes aerial combat. With deep tactical gameplay, interesting missions, and a variety of unique pilots and ships to pilot, upgrade, and master, Kamikaze Tactics will challenge and excite fans of the genre!
